headline: Exchanges Took In $468 Million Across Assets, a Turn from a $312 Million Outflow
narrative: Exchanges took in $468 million across assets in the latest day, a turn from an outflow of $312 million. The dollar pipe is mild distribution: assets arriving on exchanges where holders can sell. Bitcoin balances on those venues are higher by 17,742 coins over seven days, the coin count on the same side of the pipe.
author: jordan
